email_subject: Application - Social Media Specialist at Stanley/Stella
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Social Media Specialist role at Stanley/Stella. Your mission to redefine responsible fashion resonates deeply, and I'm excited about the opportunity to drive paid social performance across European markets.

In my current role at Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, using data from SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to guide decisions. I've also built and optimized WordPress sites, integrating social media to amplify reach. On my own project, mirook.com, I applied structured data and technical SEO to improve visibility across search engines, including AI-powered ones. While my paid social experience is growing, I'm confident in my ability to quickly master Meta Ads and HubSpot, and I bring a strong analytical mindset and commercial curiosity.

I'm eager to contribute to Stanley/Stella's digital growth and would welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Social Media Specialist position at Stanley/Stella. Your commitment to premium, sustainable apparel and your ambitious mission to redefine responsible fashion deeply resonate with me. I am eager to bring my digital marketing skills and commercial curiosity to your dynamic team.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites. I use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console to track performance and inform strategy. I also build and maintain WordPress sites, integrating social media to enhance reach. While my hands-on paid social experience is still developing, I have a solid foundation in digital marketing and a proven ability to quickly learn new platforms. I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to lead paid social campaigns on Meta and leverage AI and marketing technology to optimize results.

On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), and conducted technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project honed my analytical skills and taught me the value of experimentation and data-driven decisions. I am confident I can apply this mindset to plan, execute, and optimize paid social campaigns that generate quality leads and support business growth.

I am excited about the prospect of collaborating with Communications, Sales, and local market teams to align priorities and drive measurable impact. My background in CRM and growing interest in marketing automation (including HubSpot) position me to contribute to lead nurturing workflows and audience journeys. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am actively improving my Dutch.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Stanley/Stella's continued success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
